title: Equipment removal selects the last non-worsening slot and leaves stale scratch contents

impact.description: Retained source report; practical reachability, actual outcome and port applicability require independent review.

reported_sources.text:
`borg_remove_stuff()`: `b_p` stays `borg.power`, so the *last*
  equipment slot whose removal does not lower the power is taken off, not
  the best one, and "Power with" always prints `borg.power`. The hole
  slot is restored with `iqty = 0` only: it keeps a copy of the last
  tested item during the final `borg_notice()`.

next_at_import: Check current C and both ports, duplicate-search the exact symptom, then reproduce a legal scenario with controls before a local proposal. No C submission.
